{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ministry of InterGalactic Transit''' or '''InterGalactic Transit Office''' was a governmental agency. Among its responsibilities was the issuance of permits to allow [[free-trader]]s to legally transport and sell [[Spice/Legends|spice]].
